text:
frank (Docs): Hey all — opened PR to clean up the Dedicated provisioning doc: clarified SLA rows, added a short Terraform + Go SDK example, and fixed a handful of dead links (pricing + quotas). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1345

nina (Security): thanks — quick security check request: ensure we accurately describe KMS scoping and what keys customers can bring. Also can we be explicit about which logs are tenant-accessible vs aggregated?

frank (Docs): good call. Draft wording: "Customers can supply a customer-managed KMS key (KMS ARN) scoped to their account for model artifacts and secrets. Control-plane logs are aggregated for platform health; customers retain access to tenant-level audit logs via the console or API." Thoughts?

otto (Infra): wording looks right. Minor provider nit: Terraform attribute is kms_key_arn (not kms_key) and the pool resource is redwood_dedicated_pool. Also recommend showing burst_config as an object. I'll paste a tiny HCL sample we can include:

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "analytics" {
  name         = "analytics"
  gpu_type     = "h100-80gb"
  min_capacity = 8
  max_capacity = 64
  kms_key_arn  = "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd"
  burst_config = {
    enabled   = true
    max_burst = 16
  }
}
```

frank (Docs): swapped to kms_key_arn and burst_config. I also added a Go SDK snippet for provisioning since some customers use our infra-go client. otto, can you verify the API call?

otto (Infra): the Go client call is infra.CreatePool(ctx, CreatePoolParams{...}) and the field name is ProvisioningConfig. Example looks fine, but change method param name to ProvisioningConfig to match lib. Also note that pooled caches are tenant-isolated but control-plane metrics are aggregated — can you add that sentence to the isolation section?

frank (Docs): added the sentence. Also reworded the SLA table row for "burst fallback" to be explicit: "Burst fallback: when Dedicated pools use preemptible or fallback capacity, latency SLOs may be relaxed by up to 30% for affected requests; burst minutes are pro-rated per-minute." Is that OK?

kelly (Support): sounds customer-friendly. Can you add a short migration checklist item: "Confirm KMS permissions and VPC routing before cutover" and an example email we can send customers? Also fixed a broken link in the quotas section — replaced /pricing/dedicated with /pricing/dedicated-reserved.

frank (Docs): added migration checklist bullet and included a brief email template. Also added a short rollback procedure: configure traffic-split route to send 100% to Hosted if pool health < 50% or GPU errors > 10% for 5 minutes. nina — does that meet security/ops needs?

nina (Security): threshold numbers look conservative — ops may tweak, but we're fine documenting them as recommended defaults. Add a security note to rotate KMS keys after migration if customers bring their own.

frank (Docs): added rotation recommendation. One more CI nit — there was a bad anchor in the SLO section; I fixed the heading slug and validated build locally.

ci-bot: docs CI passed — https://ci.internal/builds/5022 :white_check_mark:

frank (Docs): thanks! merging now. I'll ping #customer-success with the migration checklist and ask Support to use the email template for customers in the migration wave. :raised_hands:
